summary: DAY expectations/execution pass covered all 12 active-batch companies while preserving the firewall between business truth/Earth Score and market opportunity. Eleven are ready_for_chief for this lane. SYM remains blocked only because the unresolved insider transaction can affect governance/alignment treatment; unavailable normalized live valuation, consensus and crowding are documented unknowns and are not baseline-promotion blockers.

materialFindings.executionView: Committed AI capacity demand is meaningful but execution depends on utilization, capex returns, financing and concentration. Live normalized valuation/crowding not canonical here; unknown rather than fabricated.
Sept. 3 Q2 results/10-Q provide a fresh operating anchor. Execution test is revenue-to-margin/cash conversion and backlog realization, not narrative contract count.

Pre-revenue/project-development economics make timing highly event-dependent. Licensing timing and future valuation remain uncertainty, but lack of canonical live price/consensus does not block baseline evidence.

Rockdale land/site control improves physical AI/HPC option set but increases execution burden: power allocation, customer contracting, financing and returns must convert before treating AI optionality as economic reality.

Sept. 8 raised 2026 revenue guidance to $450M-$460M after SkyWater acquisition is a concrete near-term execution anchor, but acquired revenue and intercompany eliminations mean the expectation bridge must distinguish consolidated execution from organic quantum-platform progress.

Backlog/RPO can support execution visibility but 90.5% quarterly customer concentration makes that visibility fragile. Insider-event substance remains unresolved; no market-timing conclusion should be drawn from the filing's existence alone.
Execution rests on design-win conversion, customer/geographic concentration and cash delivery; market AI enthusiasm must remain outside Earth Score.
Datacenter/optical growth execution depends on yields, capacity, customer mix and debt trajectory; future optical-cycle duration remains unknown.
Execution depends on hyperscaler mix, capacity and CPO adoption; dilution from convertible equitization belongs in capital-risk treatment even when non-cash accounting effects differ.
Strong current cash/revenue evidence supports execution credibility while channel/end-customer opacity and geographic manufacturing concentration remain risks.
Current margins and revenue support execution credibility; customer concentration and capital intensity define downside if AI infrastructure demand normalizes.
Diversified end markets support resilience; large acquisition integration, leverage and synergy realization are the main execution bridge rather than current crowding.

contradictions: IONQ consolidated guidance improvement is partly acquired rather than pure organic acceleration.
BTDR physical capacity option is not equivalent to contracted AI/HPC economics.
SYM backlog visibility is offset by extreme customer concentration.
unknowns: Normalized live price/valuation, consensus dispersion and crowding are not canonical T0 inputs in this pass and remain unknown.
Future event timing for OKLO and quantum adoption for IONQ remain uncertain.
SYM insider transaction substance remains unresolved.
peerRequests: Chief: do not use missing market feeds to block otherwise reproducible baseline promotion; keep Opportunity/Execution separate from Earth Score.
